Question: Minnie rides on a flat road at \(20\) kilometers per hour (kph), downhill at \(30\) kph, and uphill at \(5\) kph. Penny rides on a flat road at \(30\) kph, downhill at \(40\) kph, and uphill at \(10\) kph. Minnie goes from town \(A\) to town \(B,\) a distance of \(10\) km all uphill, then from town \(B\) to town \(C,\) a distance of \(15\) km all downhill, and then back to town \(A,\) a distance of \(20\) km on the flat. Penny goes the other way around using the same route. How many more minutes does it take Minnie to complete the \(45\)-km ride than it takes Penny?
